plan.notes:
TRACK DISCLOSURE (merge): This plan is the OFFICIAL "Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Data Science Concentration) — Suggested Plan of Study" (2025-2026, U.A. Whitaker College of Engineering, updated 7/15/2025), NOT the plain no-concentration track. The no-concentration degree map could not be cleanly recovered from official sources (exists only as a track-changes composite inside a faculty-senate revision proposal), so per the no-invention rule only the Data Science concentration was transcribed. 

Source: http://fgcu.edu/eng/computing-software-engineering/files/cs-data-science-25-26.pdf (official FGCU Department of Computing and Software Engineering, U.A. Whitaker College of Engineering; 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Data Science Concentration) — Suggested Plan of Study', 2025-2026 Academic Year, updated 7/15/2025). True degree name verified at catalog.fgcu.edu (program PDF fetched 2026-09-30): 'Computer Science (B.S.)' — 'The Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Computer Science', minimum 120 credits (https://catalog.fgcu.edu/programs/computer-science-bs/computer-science-bs.pdf). IMPORTANT TRACK DISCLOSURE: this plan is the Data Science Concentration track of the BS in Computer Science, not the no-concentration track. The BS also offers Cybersecurity and Software Engineering concentrations plus a no-concentration option; a standalone official no-concentration degree map was not available in clean form (the only official copy sits inside a faculty-senate curriculum revision proposal with track-changes insertions from the cybersecurity concentration plan, so it was not used rather than reconstructed). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the PDF's term-by-term table. Printed semester totals (14/17/9/13/12/16/15/12/12) sum to 120, matching the catalog's 120-credit minimum. Catalog year is 2025-2026, the actual year of the source (catalog.fgcu.edu still publishes 2025-2026 requirements as of 2026-09-30; a 2026-2027 revision was proposed effective Fall 2026 but is not yet published). Caveats: (1) MAC 2311 entry prerequisite is printed as 'MAC 1147 or MAC 2157' — both listed in external_prereqs as plain codes; either satisfies. Catalog footnotes add the full placement alternative (MAT 1033 then MAC 1105 then MAC 1147 with minimum grade of C, or relevant accelerated credit, or placement exam). (2) COP 4020's prereq column prints 'COP 4420 and CEN 3031 and COP 3530'; no COP 4420 exists in the program, so it is recorded as COT 4420 (Theory of Computation, the plan's theory course). (3) COP 4610 prereq is printed as 'COP 3530 & (CDA 3200 or CDA 3104)' — either CDA course satisfies; all three codes are in-plan so all are listed, and the either/or is documented here. (4) 'PHY 2048 &L' and 'PHY 2049/L' are the combined lecture+lab (4 credits each), recorded under the lecture codes PHY 2048 / PHY 2049. (5) STA 2023's entry requirement is printed as 'Test score or (MAT 1033 or MAC 1105 or MAC 1147 or MAC 2233 or MGF 1107 or MGF 1106 with minimum grade of C)' — a placement detail, so no in-plan prereq is recorded. (6) Fall Year 4 uses a two-column layout in the PDF; prereq cells were re-aligned using the same four courses/prereqs in the official 2026-2027 AI & Data Science concentration map attached to the faculty-senate revision proposal (COP 4951 requires COP 3530 and CEN 3031; STA 3038 requires STA 2023). (7) Map-wide graduation notes: students must satisfy 12 credits of College-Level Writing Skills (CLWS), Civic Literacy, Service Learning, and Foreign Language requirements in order to graduate.
